objects.taxonomy_description: Cylindrical stick of wax (15-30 cm tall, 2-5 cm diameter) with a central wick (cotton string) extending from the top. The wax body is smooth and uniform, available in white, ivory, or colored varieties. The surface has a matte or slightly glossy finish depending on wax type (paraffin, beeswax, soy). The top has a charred wick tip if previously burned. Taper candles narrow toward the top; pillar candles maintain uniform diameter. The base is flat for standing. Scented candles may have a slightly textured surface from fragrance oils. The overall shape is a simple vertical cylinder with a thin wick protruding from the center.

objects.taxonomy_description: A croissant is a buttery, flaky pastry characterized by its distinct crescent shape and laminated dough structure.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a distinctive crescent or horn-like curvature with tapered ends.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The exterior displays visible, thin, flaky layers indicative of laminated dough rather than a smooth or uniform crust.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The surface presents a golden-brown hue resulting from baking, often with slight variations in shading across the layers.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item appears as a baked food product, lacking any biological features such as fur, skin, or limbs associated with living organisms.

objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an exceptionally elongated neck that is significantly longer than the torso and legs combined.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: Features two or more short, skin-covered bony protrusions (ossicones) on the top of the head rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Proportions: Exhibits a steeply sloping back profile where the shoulders are markedly higher than the rump.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: Displays a mosaic of irregular, polygonal patches separated by lighter lines, distinct from the stripes of zebras or the uniform coats of horses.
